title: Modifying range widget with webcomponents.js included prevents render from being dispatched
body:
**Describe the bug 🐛**
We use instantsearch.js in combination with the polyfill for webcomponents, webcomponents.js. Unfortunately when using the range slider in combination with the webcomponents polyfill, an error is thrown which prevents the render event from being dispatched, something our application depends on. We thought about just listening for error event and doing what we need to do but we have found there is some strange behavior in the range slider after error.

**To Reproduce 🔍**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to https://pyrite-skate.glitch.me/ in Firefox or IE11.
2. Open dev tools.
3. Modify range slider.
4. See error variable where the debugger statement should have just landed you in the dev tools.

**Expected behavior 💭**
We would expect the render event to be fired.

**Screenshots 🖥**
![screen shot 2018-09-07 at 12 05 26 pm](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/156575/45230485-ffb9b800-b296-11e8-8c7e-87a445ffecf6.png)

**Environment:**

* OS: mac / windows
* Browser: Firefox / IE11
* Version: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/instantsearch.js@2.10.1

**Additional context**
Error message: `Error: "Failed to execute 'insertBefore' on 'Node': The node before which the new node is to be inserted is not a child of this node."`
